svg.title: Objects Are Hardware Handles
svg.desc: RoboLore instructional graphic explaining that each hardware object declaration gives a dedicated controller for one physical part. A code block on the left maps to matching hardware items on the right, including a bronze OLED module image with editable screen text and explanatory callouts.
svg.text: via the two DRV8838 driver chips (H-bridges)
front-left button (B and C get their own objects)
One declaration = one dedicated controller for one physical part. The prefix tells you exactly what you are commanding.
